apis.name: map_retained_fills
apis.description: Apply position-dependent fill colors from a query or retained read_design_context snapshots without exporting rows or resending IDs. Prefer query={scope:ids,elementIds} or query={scope:region,bounds,filter}; required columns are read and consumed internally before one atomic write. For existing snapshots pass snapshotId and its leaseId; caller-owned leases remain retained until explicit release or request settlement. Internally acquired query leases are released by this action. Request x or y columns with delivery=reference only when that result has another consumer. Coordinates are parent-local; choose an explicit domain in that space. Map normalized positions through ordered color stops. Set kind=solid to apply the mapped color visibly by clearing an existing gradient in the same write; omit kind to preserve the current paint mode and gradient. All mappings must use the same fill index and disjoint targets; one plural canonical fill call preserves shared-property validation and Undo. Mapped fields become selected-owner local overrides. Different owners may use different colors on the same shared source without detaching; unchanged source users remain unaffected.

kind.description: Convert selected Fill rows to solid paint and clear their gradient during the same color update. Omit to preserve their current paint mode.

response.description: Compact preserves ordered owner receipts and their application, settlement and mutation-scope evidence. Structural group/ungroup/move/deletion receipts return retained snapshot/lease/count references. Pass a retained reference directly into a declared elementIds argument; no model-side expansion. Read its full immutable receipt with read_design_context scope=snapshot delivery=receipt; never replay a mutation for readback. Full preserves workflow diagnostics but never bypasses a registered bounded owner view; use retained receipt readback for original acknowledgements. Uncertain receipts retain their evidence without implying completed application.

7.description: Exact registered argument path for nested or repeated fields, e.g. ["mappings",0,"query","elementIds"]. Array slots must already exist.

a.description: Resolve prepared artifact targets by exact keys. The batch binds the selected elements to the operation argument.

field.description: Exact canonical element-identity argument name. Its schema declares all, each or one binding cardinality; for example anchorId is exactly one.

results.interpretation: Read the owner result and toolOutcome.status with settlement. Completed execution is not visual approval or durable storage. Preserve completed work on partial/failed results; unknown settlement is not permission to replay. Use the owner recovery and returned next arguments. Complete result schemas are available with includeResultSchema=true when a machine consumer needs validation.

usageGuide.recovery: Compact preserves ordered owner receipts and their application, settlement and mutation-scope evidence. Structural group/ungroup/move/deletion receipts return retained snapshot/lease/count references. Pass a retained reference directly into a declared elementIds argument; no model-side expansion. Read its full immutable receipt with read_design_context scope=snapshot delivery=receipt; never replay a mutation for readback. Full preserves workflow diagnostics but never bypasses a registered bounded owner view; use retained receipt readback for original acknowledgements. Uncertain receipts retain their evidence without implying completed application. Inspect the retained write receipt and check diagnostics before continuing; do not replay acknowledged mutations.
